topic.label: Taxes and Personal Finance
topic.desc: Personal money: income tax preparation and filing, deductions and credits, investment and crypto taxes, budgeting and saving, and retirement planning.

concepts.label: Budgeting and Saving
concepts.desc: Budgets, cash flow, emergency funds, debt payoff and saving goals.

concepts.label: Deductions, Credits and Tax Planning
concepts.desc: Standard and itemized deductions, credits, brackets and planning to reduce tax legally.

concepts.label: Tax Preparation and Filing
concepts.desc: Preparing and filing income tax returns: forms, documents, deadlines and e-filing.

concepts.label: Investment and Crypto Taxes
concepts.desc: Capital gains, cost basis, wash sales, dividends and crypto tax reporting.

concepts.label: Retirement Planning
concepts.desc: Retirement accounts, contribution limits, withdrawals and projecting retirement income.

skills.label: Budget Builder

skills.desc: Finds deductions and credits that may apply and the evidence each needs.

skills.desc: Lists federal and state tax filing and estimated payment deadlines.

skills.desc: Helps prepare and file your taxes: lists the forms and documents needed to prepare a tax return for a situation.

skills.label: Capital Gains Calculator
skills.desc: Computes short and long term capital gains from trades with cost basis method stated.

skills.label: Retirement Projection
skills.desc: Projects retirement savings and income under stated assumptions.
